title: ElementalCrystals
description:
ElementalCrystals adds custom elemental crystals with special abilities.
Players can craft and use Fire and Water Crystals in survival gameplay. 

Thanks
body:
**════════════════════════════
ElementalCrystals – Version 1.0
════════════════════════════**
**ElementalCrystals** is a custom Paper 
plugin for Minecraft **1.21.x** that 
introduces a unique **elemental crystal** 
system to enhance survival, combat, 
and gameplay progression. Players can craft,
collect, and use Fire and Water Crystals with 
special abilities that impact both PvE and PvP experiences.
**────────────────────────────
Key Features
────────────────────────────**
**Fire Crystal** – Deals damage and ignites
nearby enemies when activated, perfect for combat.
**Water Crystal** – Provides healing and resistance
effects to improve survivability during fights.
**Crafting Recipes** – Balanced recipes allow players 
to obtain crystals naturally through survival without commands.
**Cooldown System** – Prevents ability spam, keeping
gameplay fair in multiplayer.
**────────────────────────────
Plugin Details
────────────────────────────**
The plugin is built with Java 17 and
the Paper API, ensuring stable performance
on modern servers. It is lightweight,
optimized, and designed to integrate
smoothly with vanilla Minecraft mechanics. 
The modular structure allows for future
expansions, including additional elemental
crystals, new abilities, and configurable options.
**────────────────────────────
Why Use ElementalCrystals
────────────────────────────**
This plugin adds a fresh layer of strategy 
to survival gameplay. Players can enhance 
their combat style, gain advantages in PvE 
battles, and explore creative ways to combine
elemental powers. It is easy to use, stable, 
and provides a strong foundation for future content updates.
════════════════════════════
